objective: Validate Full, Fixed Sector, and Adaptive over seven fixed maps after retaining Full acquisition through a certified clearance-escape prefix until a current ordinary certificate permits Sector release.

stages.stage1: repetitions 1-5; all 35 triplets must pass infrastructure/source gates before stage2

mode_order: Deterministic rotating order within every triplet.
blocking_gate: Stop on any infrastructure/source error, or any Full/Adaptive non-completion, contact, speed violation, or strict recovery-audit failure. Retain Sector safety/non-completion as an outcome if the run is otherwise valid.
required_adaptive_contract: Every completed Full-recovery cycle has exactly one fresh source frame, one committed acknowledgement, one newer certified path and one Sector return; escape-prefix paths retain Full until an ordinary current certificate permits release.
predeclared_metrics: Adaptive Full-open transitions and refresh acknowledgements

prior_evidence.c32_stop: Urban repeat 2 Adaptive committed a certified clearance escape, closed Full before executing it, immediately failed the Sector-updated main guard, and timed out after a second recovery cycle.
prior_evidence.c33_smoke: Urban Adaptive run83126 completed 5/5 with contact 0 and a valid strict one-to-one recovery audit; run83127 also completed 5/5/contact 0 but its manual postprocessor was launched from the wrong cwd and is retained only as flight evidence.

claim_limit: Finite simulation evidence on the declared maps; not a population-level or real-world guarantee.
